title: benchmarkEvaluate
responsibility: Evaluates only allowed implementation changes against a fresh baseline with protected acceptance checks.

inputs.name: evaluateBenchmarkSubmission.input
inputs.description: A benchmark definition, baseline snapshot path, submitted workspace path, evaluation path, repository-relative file list and cancellation signal. Evaluation compares the workspace with the baseline, rebuilds the evaluation path, applies submitted changes and runs checks.

inputs.name: setupBenchmarkWorkspace.cwd
inputs.description: Directory used as the current working directory for each configured setup command. Commands run sequentially and stop at the first nonzero exit code.

inputs.name: setupBenchmarkWorkspace.definition
inputs.description: A parsed benchmark definition used to select allowed files, setup commands and acceptance checks. It requires at least one allowed relative file, check and candidate; allowed paths cannot contain dot, parent, backslash or .git segments, and budgets bound repetitions to 1–100, timeout to 100–86400000 ms and repairs to 0–10.

examples.name: unit-smoke-check
examples.contract: Change only src/example.ts and leave the checks passing.

inputs.name: setupBenchmarkWorkspace.signal
inputs.description: Signal observed by each setup process so cancellation or the trial deadline can stop it. If already aborted before a process starts, its configured reason is propagated.

outputs.name: evaluateBenchmarkSubmission
outputs.description: Resolves to whether all acceptance checks exited successfully, repository-relative invalid file paths, each check's exit code and captured output, and the staged binary diff from the evaluation HEAD. Invalid files short-circuit to passed=false with no checks and an empty patch.

outputs.name: setupBenchmarkWorkspace
outputs.description: Resolves with no value after all setup commands exit with code 0; the first nonzero exit rejects. Commands run sequentially in cwd and receive the supplied abort signal.

errors.name: Benchmark Git or setup command failed
errors.description: Thrown when a benchmark Git helper receives a nonzero exit status or a setup command exits nonzero; awaited filesystem helpers may also reject with I/O errors.

errors.name: BoundedCommandFailure
errors.description: Rejected when a benchmark child cannot start, exceeds commandDeadlines.benchmarkChildMs or the 8000000-byte output limit, or is aborted while running.

errors.name: AbortSignal.reason
errors.description: If the supplied signal is already aborted before a child starts, throwIfAborted propagates its caller-supplied reason unchanged; its runtime name and shape are not constrained.
